verdict.rationale: Paddle's hosted MCP server lets agents act on the account, including "Build and evolve your pricing model." Its codemode `execute` tool chains multiple Paddle API calls in a single invocation, and the agent skills cover catalog setup and checkout, so an agent can plausibly provision a catalog and checkout in one session. Transactions can also be created via the API, and a sandbox with `pdl_sdbx_` keys allows safe testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the API creates shareable payment/checkout links (only transaction creation is evidenced), explicit product/price create endpoints in the pack, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an end-to-end agent provisioning session.
